profile.about_content:
I am Ali Husnain, a Computer Science student and NAVTTC-certified Full-Stack Web Developer. I enjoy building modern websites, responsive web applications, management dashboards, mobile applications, and AI-powered digital solutions.

My technical interests include frontend development, backend systems, modern web technologies, application development, and intelligent automation.

I focus on creating useful, user-friendly, responsive, and practical digital experiences while continuously improving my development skills.
profile.career_objective: To leverage hands-on project experience and technical problem-solving skills in full-stack JavaScript (MERN/MEAN), Python backend development, and AI workflow automation to deliver innovative, high-quality software solutions.
profile.professional_interests: Frontend & Full-Stack Web Architecture, Scalable RESTful APIs, Administrative Dashboards, Mobile Application Development, and Intelligent AI Workflow Automation (Gemini API, LLMs, n8n, WhatsApp Automation).
profile.development_philosophy: Writing clean, structured, and maintainable code paired with accessible, intuitive user interfaces—focusing on practical real-world utility, responsive performance, and continuous improvement.
profile.current_learning_goals: Advancing proficiency in Next.js App Router, TypeScript system architecture, PostgreSQL & Supabase backend design, and real-time multi-modal AI integrations.

projects.title: Noor-ul-Quran — Digital Quran & Islamic Learning Platform
projects.description: A modern full-stack TypeScript and React web application built with Supabase, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui for reading, exploring, and studying the Holy Quran.
projects.detailed_description: Noor-ul-Quran is a responsive, accessible full-stack web application engineered with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase integration. It provides a clean, distraction-free interface for reading Surahs, managing bookmarks, and navigating verses with fast client-side caching powered by TanStack React Query.
projects.problem_solved: Many traditional Quran websites suffer from cluttered layouts, slow page loads, and poor mobile responsiveness. Noor-ul-Quran solves this with a modern component architecture, dark/light mode support, and fast state management.
main_features: Responsive Surah and Ayah reader interface with clean typography
Supabase backend integration with TanStack React Query data fetching
Accessible UI built on Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS
Dark and light reading themes with persistent user preferences
projects.development_approach: Built using a modular component-driven architecture in TypeScript, combining Radix UI primitives (shadcn/ui), React Router DOM, Zod validation, and Supabase client services.
projects.future_improvements: Add offline PWA audio recitation caching and multi-language translation comparison views.
projects.historical_commits_note: February 2026 — 5 commits recorded in supplied contribution history

projects.title: MJ & Zoya AI Assistant — Real-Time Gemini AI Task & Voice Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered task management and conversational assistant built with React, TypeScript, Express, SQLite, and the official Google GenAI SDK (@google/genai).
projects.detailed_description: Developed across the MJ-AI-ASSISTENT and Zoya_Ai-assistent repositories, this project integrates the Google Gemini API (@google/genai) with a React 19 + TypeScript frontend, Framer Motion animations, and an Express + better-sqlite3 backend to provide real-time conversational assistance and intelligent task organization.
projects.problem_solved: Bridges conversational LLM capabilities with structured personal task management in a low-latency browser interface.
main_features: Direct integration with Google Gemini API (@google/genai) for intelligent responses and voice/chat interaction
Full-stack persistence using Express.js and better-sqlite3 in MJ-AI-ASSISTENT
Modern interactive interface styled with Tailwind CSS v4 and Framer Motion animations
Deployed live browser assistant edition via Vercel (Zoya AI Assistant)
projects.development_approach: Constructed with TypeScript, Vite, React, and Express, separating AI prompt orchestration from UI state and local SQLite persistence.
projects.future_improvements: Expand multi-step tool calling and calendar webhook triggers.

projects.title: WhatsApp AI Automation Bot & Webhook Server
projects.description: Node.js and Express.js WhatsApp automation server utilizing whatsapp-web.js, Puppeteer, and custom webhook endpoints for automated messaging workflows.
projects.detailed_description: whatsapp-bot-ready is a backend automation service built with Node.js, Express, Puppeteer, qrcode-terminal, and whatsapp-web.js. It provides QR-based session authentication, persistent local session caching, and REST webhook endpoints (/test-webhook) to connect WhatsApp messaging with external AI and n8n automation pipelines.
projects.problem_solved: Enables programmatic WhatsApp message handling and webhook-driven automation without manual intervention.
main_features: QR-code terminal authentication with automatic session persistence
Express.js REST webhook endpoints for incoming and outgoing message triggers
Automated shell and Node.js webhook test suites (test-webhook.sh, test.js)
Designed to pair with n8n workflows and LLM response pipelines
projects.development_approach: Engineered in Node.js with Express and whatsapp-web.js, featuring modular webhook routing and automated connection recovery.
projects.future_improvements: Add multi-session dashboard monitoring and rate-limited message queue workers.

projects.title: Free-LLM — Multi-Provider OpenAI-Compatible API Router
projects.description: TypeScript & Docker-ready LLM gateway aggregating free tiers across 16 AI providers into a unified OpenAI-compatible API endpoint with client, server, and desktop modules.
projects.detailed_description: Hosted in Husnain0018/Free-LLM and deployed to Vercel, this TypeScript full-stack workspace (based on the open-source FreeLLMAPI architecture) aggregates free-tier LLM providers (Google Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, Mistral, OpenRouter, GitHub Models, Cohere, Cloudflare, HuggingFace, Ollama, etc.) behind a unified OpenAI-compatible interface.
projects.problem_solved: Simplifies working with multiple free-tier LLM providers by unifying authentication, model routing, and fallback handling behind a single endpoint.
main_features: Unified OpenAI-compatible API routing across multiple LLM providers
Full TypeScript monorepo structure with client, server, shared, and Docker support
Live server deployment hosted on Vercel
projects.development_approach: Structured as a multi-package TypeScript application with Docker containerization and Vercel deployment configuration. Note: Adapted/configured from open-source FreeLLMAPI project.
projects.future_improvements: Integrate custom usage analytics and local token budget alerts.
projects.attribution_note: Repository adapted and deployed from open-source FreeLLMAPI architecture.

projects.title: User Management Dashboard — Admin Panel & Node.js Backend
projects.description: Interactive administrative user management dashboard with a Node.js backend script and responsive frontend interface for managing user records and statuses.
projects.detailed_description: Developed across the -User_Management_Dashboard and -User-Management-Dashboard repositories, this project provides a clean administrative interface for viewing, filtering, and managing user accounts, paired with a Node.js backend script and live Vercel deployment.
projects.problem_solved: Provides a centralized, responsive dashboard layout for administrative user CRUD workflows and status monitoring.
main_features: Administrative table and card views for user directory management
Responsive dashboard navigation and metric summary cards
Node.js backend entry point (index.js) paired with frontend.html UI
Live web deployment hosted on Vercel
projects.development_approach: Built using semantic HTML5, modern CSS dashboard layouts, JavaScript DOM state management, and Node.js.
projects.future_improvements: Connect directly to PostgreSQL with role-based access control (RBAC) audit logging.

projects.title: Advanced QR Code Generator & Scanner (Web & Mobile Capacitor)
projects.description: Cross-platform web and Capacitor mobile application for generating customized QR codes, scanning QR codes, managing history, and sharing exports.
projects.detailed_description: QR-code-generater is a practical utility application built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Capacitor (capacitor.config.json) for packaging as a mobile application. Users can generate QR codes with custom foreground/background colors, scan codes, browse generation history, and toggle dark/light themes.
projects.problem_solved: Eliminates ads and watermarks found on commercial QR generators by offering an instant client-side generator and scanner with local history.
main_features: Custom QR code generation with color customization
Built-in QR scanning support and share options
Local generation history and dark/light theme toggle
Configured with Capacitor for mobile application deployment
projects.development_approach: Implemented with modular vanilla JavaScript and wrapped with Capacitor for hybrid mobile compatibility.
projects.future_improvements: Add SVG vector export and batch CSV-to-QR generation.

projects.title: Kanbaneve — Interactive Kanban Board & Task Workflow App
projects.description: A modern Kanban task management application built with JavaScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS for organizing workflows across customizable columns.
projects.detailed_description: Kanbaneve is a frontend productivity application built with Vite, Tailwind CSS, and modular JavaScript inside a clean `src` architecture. It enables users to organize tasks visually across workflow stages with responsive layout styling.
projects.problem_solved: Provides a lightweight, fast-loading Kanban task board directly in the browser.
main_features: Multi-column Kanban workflow layout
Built with Vite and Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite)
Responsive task cards and clean visual hierarchy
Deployed live on Vercel
projects.development_approach: Developed using Vite bundler and utility-first Tailwind CSS styling with modular JavaScript state handlers.
projects.future_improvements: Add drag-and-drop column reordering and cloud sync.

projects.title: Student Management System & BST/AVL Tree Suite in C++
projects.description: Academic C++ systems suite featuring a Doubly Linked List Student Management System, a BST & AVL Self-Balancing Tree Builder, and an OOP Text-Based Dungeon Crawler.
projects.detailed_description: Created during BS Computer Science coursework at the University of Gujrat, this C++ collection spans three verified repositories: Student-Management-System-using-Doubly-Linked-List (student.cpp), BST-and-AVL-Tree-Project-in-C- (tree.cpp), and text-based-dungeon-crawler-game- (dungeon_crawler.cpp). Together they demonstrate core mastery of pointers, memory management, self-balancing binary trees, doubly linked lists, and object-oriented C++ design.
projects.problem_solved: Implements foundational computer science data structures from scratch in standard C++ without relying on high-level external libraries.
main_features: Student record insertion, search, update, and deletion using a custom Doubly Linked List (student.cpp)
Interactive Binary Search Tree (BST) and self-balancing AVL Tree builder with Inorder, Preorder, and Postorder traversals (tree.cpp)
Object-Oriented C++ Dungeon Crawler game with procedural room navigation, inventory, and combat mechanics (dungeon_crawler.cpp)
projects.development_approach: Written in standard C++ (compiled via g++) focusing on algorithmic efficiency, pointer safety, and clear CLI interaction.
projects.future_improvements: Add file serialization and a WebAssembly visualization wrapper.
projects.historical_commits_note: January 2026 — 7 combined commits across C++ academic project repositories
